remarks: Welcome to Palmer Hill, Stamford's premier, gated, resort style luxury townhouse community! With the stunning clubhouse & amenities greeting you as you enter to the grounds, you see the quality & attention to detail everywhere.   Beautiful 3 bed 3.1 bath 3000+ sf unit. Open floor plan w/ center island kitchen opens to living room w/ gas fireplace & built ins, eat in area, & access to wonderful, private patio for summer BBQs & relaxation. Flooded w/ natural light! Upstairs primary suite w/ spa like full bath glass stall shower, soaking tub, & double vanity. 2 additional bedrooms. Lower level flex space w/ full bath & tons of storage. Attached 2 car garage.   Convenient location on border of Old Greenwich/Stamford is close to train stations, grocery stores, restaurants, beaches, etc.
